tweet.text: I don’t know why you’re saddened. These tools are very powerful and they’re very useful. On the other hand, I don’t think I’m “vibe“ coding. I am very carefully supervising and instructing a powerful tool. That’s nothing unusual. I’ve been doing that for well over 50 years. The only difference is that the tools are more powerful now.
